notes: Driver cache control changed only CUDA_CACHE_PATH between fresh and reused cases; identical engine binary and workload.
Copied bake uses a newly prepared private cache copied to a different serving path. It excludes transfer and extraction.
Reference is offline vLLM LLM, with max context 128, max sequences 8, 1 GiB fixed KV, eager execution and no prefix caching. Its ready time is not an HTTP first-token measurement.
The 16-request parity corpus forces 32 output tokens with ignore_eos=true. Some comparisons extend beyond normal EOS.
Post-divergence positional agreement is an output comparison, not teacher-forced numerical accuracy.
Strict parity is not passed. Neither candidate nor vLLM itself produces identical full sequences for every single versus batched run.
